script:
set -eu
fail() { printf 'STOP=%s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 42; }
boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
printf 'BOOT_ID=%s\n' "$boot"
[ "$boot" = 8e816d98-6bf4-4f9e-9abe-891fbf83d06f ] || fail unexpected_boot
ui=$(systemctl show xochitl.service -p MainPID --value)
printf 'UI_PID=%s\n' "$ui"
[ "$ui" = 7146 ] || fail unexpected_ui_pid
systemctl show xochitl.service --no-pager -p ActiveState -p SubState -p NRestarts
app=$(readlink /home/root/xovi/exthome/appload/pi-annotations)
patch=$(readlink /home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/pi-annotations.qmd)
[ "$app" = '/home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/releases/ba36897369a1c89f3299ca87e5b8a4fd9db919116580315095133ac2ffa3cb33/app' ] || fail app_link
[ "$patch" = '/home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/releases/ba36897369a1c89f3299ca87e5b8a4fd9db919116580315095133ac2ffa3cb33/sidebar.qmd' ] || fail patch_link
printf 'APP_TARGET=%s\nPATCH_TARGET=%s\n' "$app" "$patch"
found=0
for p in $(pidof pi-ink-client || :); do
 case "$p" in ''|*[!0-9]*) fail client_pid;; esac
 exe=$(readlink "/proc/$p/exe" || :)
 if [ "$exe" = '/home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/releases/ba36897369a1c89f3299ca87e5b8a4fd9db919116580315095133ac2ffa3cb33/pi-ink-client' ]; then
  found=$((found+1))
  bytes=$(sha256sum "/proc/$p/exe")
  hash=${bytes%% *}
  [ "$hash" = '433d53403a9d3568a00458fe9a02af33813cbdce0489b0b8602693f0ff135051' ] || fail client_binary_hash
  printf 'CLIENT_PID=%s\nCLIENT_EXE=%s\nCLIENT_SHA256=%s\n' "$p" "$exe" "$hash"
 fi
done
[ "$found" = 1 ] || fail unique_expected_client
printf 'MOD_RUNTIME_MAPS_BEGIN\n'
while IFS= read -r line; do case "$line" in */home/root/xovi/xovi.so|*/home/root/xovi/extensions.d/appload.so|*/home/root/xovi/extensions.d/qt-resource-rebuilder.so) printf '%s\n' "$line";; esac; done < "/proc/$ui/maps"
printf 'MOD_RUNTIME_MAPS_END\n'
stat -c 'PRIVATE_META|%n|%F|%u|%g|%a|%s' /home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/config.json /home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/server-ca.pem
printf 'NATIVE_VERIFICATION_COMPLETE\n'
